title: spec(ui): the bulk-action JSDoc, refusal prescription and view.json liveness row still say the bulk path drops a lookup param's `lookupFilters` / `lookupColumns` / `lookupPageSize` / `descriptionField`
body:
Filing gate **① a defect with a named location**: shipped spec prose that teaches the wrong behaviour. This is follow-up owed by landed work: the spec half of #26951, split off by ui seat 2 because a `packages/spec/src/**` diff sits behind the Clause-② queue gate's path limb.

`finding` class **b** · `reach:` named producer. PR #27049 (`Refs #26951`, ui seat 2 ACCEPT) changes `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/resolveBulkActions.ts` `toBulkParam` to forward the four lookup settings, so each sentence below becomes false once it merges.

## What is wrong (read at `origin/main` `cb8988ee`; the os-dev report on #26951, comment 6459668393, `out_of_scope_findings`)

1. `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` ≈L161–163, the JSDoc above `BULK_PARAM_WIDGET_CONFIG_KEYS`: "The lookup settings lookupFilters / lookupColumns / lookupPageSize / descriptionField are resolved and then dropped by the bulk adapter" (and "From THIS list only accept and maxSize make the trip").
2. `packages/spec/src/ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` ≈L260–262, the refusal prescription: "So of these keys only accept / maxSize arrive that way: the picker settings lookupFilters / lookupColumns / lookupPageSize / descriptionField are dropped on the bulk path".
3. `packages/spec/liveness/view.json` ≈L198, row `list.bulkActionDefs`: "... #toBulkParam, which carries ... and drops the lookup settings."

## Expected

All three say that a promoted bulk action's field-backed lookup param carries the field's `lookupFilters`, `lookupColumns`, `lookupPageSize` and `descriptionField` to the selection bar's picker, the same as the single-record dialog. `idField` / `titleFormat` are still not carried, so keep any sentence about those. The refusal prescription's accept set does not change: this is prose, not schema.

## Business reason

App authors read this JSDoc and its refusal text, through the skills and the metadata form help, to decide whether a bulk action's lookup is narrowed. Once #27049 lands, the spec would tell them to work around a drop that no longer happens. Without this fix the published `@objectstack/spec` contradicts the console.

## Reader who acts

The `domain:spec` seat, in one PR touching those two files, after PR #27049 merges. Re-read the line numbers then.

## Dedupe

Listed `domain:spec` issues (state all, newest 300) and checked titles and leads for bulk / lookupFilters: 0 hits on this prose. The related closed cards #25205 and #24798 are about `confirmText`, not lookup settings.
